en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 441 - It is narrated from Fadhl bin Shazan from Nasr bin Muzahim from Amr bin Shimr from Jabir that he said:
“I asked Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s): When will this event occur? He replied: Jabir, it will occur at a time when killing between Hira and Kufa is considerable.”
